10511-a-rogue-by-compulsion-an-affair-of.creator: Victor Bridges
10511-a-rogue-by-compulsion-an-affair-of.description: A book by Victor Bridges. My one chance lay in reaching the main wood that borders the Tavistock road before the mounted guard could come up. Between this and the plantation stretched a long bare slope of hillside, perhaps two hundred yards across, with scarcely enough cover on it to hide a rabbit. It was not exactly an inviting prospect, but still the place had to be crossed, and there was nothing to be gained by looking at it.

arxiv-1809-04235.title: Risk-Limiting Audits by Stratified Union-Intersection Tests of Elections (SUITE)
arxiv-1809-04235.creator: Kellie Ottoboni, Philip B. Stark, Mark Lindeman, Neal McBurnett
arxiv-1809-04235.description: Abstract Risk-limiting audits (RLAs) offer a statistical guarantee: if a full manual tally of the paper ballots would show that the reported election outcome is wrong, an RLA has a known minimum chance of leading to a full manual tally. RLAs generally rely on random samples.

arxiv-2010-06858.title: fugashi, a Tool for Tokenizing Japanese in Python
arxiv-2010-06858.creator: Paul McCann
arxiv-2010-06858.description: Abstract Recent years have seen an increase in the number of large-scale multilingual NLP projects. However, even in such projects, languages with special processing requirements are often excluded. One such language is Japanese. Japanese is written without spaces, tokenization is non-trivial, and while high quality open source tokenizers exist they can be hard to use and lack English documentation.

arxiv-2011-11356.title: Average cluster size inside sediment left after droplet desiccation
arxiv-2011-11356.creator: P A Zolotarev 1,2, K S Kolegov 1,2,3
arxiv-2011-11356.description: Abstract In this work, we continue to study the formation of particle chains (clusters) inside the annular sediment during the drying of a colloidal droplet on a substrate. The average value of the cluster size was determined after processing experimental data from other authors.

arxiv-2206-14692.title: A Combination Theorem for Trees of Metric Bundles Thanks: This paper is part of R. Halder’s PhD thesis written under the supervision of P. Sardar.
arxiv-2206-14692.creator: Rakesh Halder
arxiv-2206-14692.description: Abstract . Motivated by the work of Bestvina-Feighn ( [ BF92 ] ) and Mj-Sardar ( [ MS12 ] ), we define trees of metric bundles subsuming both the trees of metric spaces and the metric bundles. Then we prove a combination theorem for these spaces.

arxiv-2208-06932.title: Partition Rank and Partition Lattices Thanks: Department of Mathematics and Statistics, York University. 4700 Keele St. Toronto, Ontario, Canada. M3J 1P3
arxiv-2208-06932.creator: Mohamed Omar
arxiv-2208-06932.description: Abstract . We introduce a universal approach for applying the partition rank method, an extension of Tao’s slice rank polynomial method, to tensors that are not diagonal. This is accomplished by generalizing Naslund’s distinctness indicator to what we call a partition indicator .

arxiv-2404-11505.title: Sky location of Massive Black Hole Binaries in the foreground of Galactic white dwarf binaries
arxiv-2404-11505.creator: Pan Guo 1,4, Hong-Bo Jin 1,2,3, Cong-Feng Qiao 1,4, Yue-Liang Wu 1,4,5
arxiv-2404-11505.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pan Guo 1,4, Hong-Bo Jin 1,2,3, Cong-Feng Qiao 1,4, Yue-Liang Wu 1,4,5. For space-based gravitational wave (GW) detection, the main noise source for massive black hole binaries (MBHBs) is attributed to approximately 10 7 10^{7} double white dwarf binaries in the foreground. For a GW source, the amplitude of the detector response, recorded by a space-based gravitational wave detector, exhibits a modulation effect with a year period when observing the source from various orbital positions.

arxiv-2508-04546.title: Hierarchical Event Memory for Accurate and Low-latency Online Video Temporal Grounding
arxiv-2508-04546.creator: Minghang Zheng, Yuxin Peng, Benyuan Sun, Yi Yang, Yang Liu
arxiv-2508-04546.description: Abstract In this paper, we tackle the task of online video temporal grounding (OnVTG), which requires the model to locate events related to a given text query within a video stream. Unlike regular video temporal grounding, OnVTG requires the model to make predictions without observing future frames.

europmc-pmc5337963.title: Pupil-linked arousal is driven by decision uncertainty and alters serial choice bias.
europmc-pmc5337963.creator: Urai AE, Braun A, Donner TH.
europmc-pmc5337963.description: While judging their sensory environments, decision-makers seem to use the uncertainty about their choices to guide adjustments of their subsequent behaviour. One possible source of these behavioural adjustments is arousal: decision uncertainty might drive the brain's arousal...

pmc-11517127.title: The Effect of Text messages and Education on Cancer Screening in Women Aged 30-65
pmc-11517127.creator: H Kutman, H Kadıoğlu
pmc-11517127.description: BackgroundDespite it is known that cancer screenings reduce cancer-related deaths, screening rates are still inadequate. The aim of this study is to examine the effect of text messaging and training on cancer screening in women aged 30-65.MethodsThis non-randomized controlled trial was conducted with 120 women aged 30-65 between November 2023 and April 2024 in Tekirdağ, Türkiye.

pmc-11642326.title: Comparison of Postoperative Breast Asymmetry Using Vectra 3D Imaging in Prepectoral Versus Subpectoral Implant-Based Breast Reconstruction
pmc-11642326.creator: Seung-Ho Choi, Sang-Oh Lee, Kyu-Jin Chung, Il-Kug Kim, Jun-Ho Lee
pmc-11642326.description: Background/Objectives: Implant-based breast reconstruction (IBBR) is increasingly favored over autologous reconstruction due to its procedural simplicity and recovery benefits. Conducting this reconstruction using either the subpectoral or prepectoral planes has varied aesthetic outcomes. This study utilizes VECTRA XT 3D imaging to objectively assess breast symmetry differences between these surgical techniques.

pmc-11657827.title: Development and validation of a Prediction Model for Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Disease
pmc-11657827.creator: Guixiang Liu, Jing Wen, Chunyi Lv, Mingjie Liu, Min Li, Kexia Fang, Jianwen Fei, Nannan Zhang, Xuehua Li, Huarui Wang, Yuanyuan Sun, Ling Zhu
pmc-11657827.description: BackgroundAcute pulmonary embolism (APE) is a critical disease with a high mortality rate, some of the surviving patients may develop chronic thromboembolic pulmonary disease (CTEPD), which affects the patient’s prognosis. However, the research on the early diagnosis of CTEPD is limited. This study aimed to establish a prediction model for earlier identification of CTEPD.

pmc-11669523.title: Impact of vancomycin therapeutic drug monitoring on mortality in sepsis patients across different age groups: a propensity score-matched retrospective cohort study
pmc-11669523.creator: Huaidong Peng, Ruichang Zhang, Shuangwu Zhou, Tingting Xu, Ruolun Wang, Qilin Yang, Xunlong Zhong, Xiaorui Liu
pmc-11669523.description: BackgroundDue to its potent antibacterial activity, vancomycin is widely used in the treatment of sepsis. Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) can optimize personalized vancomycin dosing regimens, enhancing therapeutic efficacy and minimizing nephrotoxic risk, thereby potentially improving patient outcomes. However, it remains uncertain whether TDM affects the mortality rate among sepsis patients or whether age plays a role in this outcome.

pmc-11679557.title: Connectivity Recovery Based on Boundary Nodes and Spatial Triangle Fermat Points for Three-Dimensional Wireless Sensor Networks
pmc-11679557.creator: Hongsheng Chen, Ke Shi
pmc-11679557.description: In recent years, wireless sensor networks have been widely used, especially in three-dimensional environments such as underwater and mountain environments. However, in harsh environments, wireless sensor networks may be damaged and split into many isolated islands. Therefore, restoring network connectivity to transmit data effectively in a timely manner is particularly important.

pmc-12528944.title: Outcomes of Platelet-Rich Plasma Versus Dextrose 10% Prolotherapy in the Treatment of Osgood-Schlatter Disease: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12528944.creator: Rahul Thapa, Arun H Shanthappa, Sunil Chandrashekar, Ayush Agrawal
pmc-12528944.description: Background: Osgood-Schlatter disease (OSD) is a common overuse injury affecting adolescents engaged in physical activities. While conservative treatment remains the standard, refractory cases may benefit from regenerative therapies, such as platelet-rich plasma (PRP) and 10% dextrose prolotherapy (DPT). Comparative evidence between these interventions in OSD is limited.

pmc-12571771.title: Elucidating the Anticancer Mechanisms of Tetrahydroxycurcumin: A Comprehensive Review of Preclinical Studies
pmc-12571771.creator: Muhammad Shahbaz, Ushna Momal, Hagar M Mohamed, Asfa Perween, Hammad Naeem, Muhammad Imran, Muzzamal Hussain, Gamal A Mohamed, Sabrin R M Ibrahim, Tadesse Fenta Yehuala, Suliman A Alsagaby, Waleed Al Abdulmonem, Mohamed A Abdelgawad, Ehab M Mostafa, Samy Selim
pmc-12571771.description: One significant reductive metabolite of curcumin, tetrahydroxycurcumin (THC), is a promising oncology candidate because of its multifunctional bioactivities. Preclinical data indicate that THC has a strong anti‐inflammatory, antioxidant, and anticancer profile, and as such, it is a better alternative to curcumin in treatment.

pmc-12687924.title: Androgen Receptor Signaling Inhibitors in Non‐Metastatic Castration‐Resistant Prostate Cancer in Japan: The ARASHI Study
pmc-12687924.creator: Kazuhiro Suzuki, Nasreen Khan, Tomoyuki Taguchi, Kana Hattori, Guifang Chen, Mercedeh Ghadessi, Niculae Constantinovici, Vanessa Quintero, Hiroyoshi Suzuki
pmc-12687924.description: ObjectivesTo describe clinical use and outcomes of androgen receptor signaling inhibitors (ARSIs) darolutamide, enzalutamide, and apalutamide in patients with non‐metastatic castration‐resistant prostate cancer (nmCRPC) in Japan.MethodsThis retrospective, observational study examined health claims data from acute care hospitals (Medical Data Vision Co. Ltd. database) in Japan, for patients with nmCRPC initiating an ARSI between February 2020 and April 2023.

pmc-12831075.title: Precision, Personalization, and Progress: A New Era in Foot and Ankle Surgery
pmc-12831075.creator: Soheil Ashkani-Esfahani, Lercan Aslan
pmc-12831075.description: er region do we ask so many joints, packed into such a small volume, to deliver both precision and resilience, every minute of every day. During a single gait cycle, the foot must behave like two different structures: a “flexible adaptor” at initial contact and midstance, then a “rigid lever” for push-off.

pmc-13058484.title: Developing implementation strategies for the framework and strategy for disability and rehabilitation in South Africa: An approach using the Expert Recommendations for Implementing Change framework
pmc-13058484.creator: Naeema A.R. Reis, Sonti Pilusa, Natalie Benjamin-Damons, Juliana Kagura
pmc-13058484.description: BackgroundThe expiry of South Africa’s Framework and Strategy for Disability and Rehabilitation (FSDR) created an opportunity to critically assess its effectiveness, strengths and limitations to inform the development of a new disability and rehabilitation policy.ObjectivesAs the primary gap in the FSDR related to weak implementation rather than policy intent, this study aimed to develop evidence-informed implementation strategies.

pmc-13117428.title: Common Skin Diseases and Metabolic Syndrome: A Proinflammatory Chemokine Perspective
pmc-13117428.creator: Mateusz Matwiejuk, Hanna Myśliwiec, Agnieszka Mikłosz, Adrian Chabowski, Iwona Flisiak
pmc-13117428.description: Skin diseases frequently coexist with other disorders, such as metabolic syndrome, diabetes mellitus, depression, psoriatic arthritis, and cardiovascular disease. Altered levels of distinct chemokines, like CCL5/RANTES, CXCL12/SDF-1a, CCL7/MCP-3, CCL2/MCP-1, CXCL1/GROa, and the eotaxin family, contribute to the development and/or exacerbation of inflammation, which is a common feature of numerous skin diseases as well as metabolic syndrome.

pmc-13247877.title: A diagnostic dilemma: uterine adenomyoma mimicking an accessory cavitated uterine malformation on imaging
pmc-13247877.creator: Jing Wang, Juan Zou, Heng Zhang, Yali Chen
pmc-13247877.description: , beginning on day 1 of her menstrual cycle and lasting throughout the period. The patient’s symptoms proved refractory to oral non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). Initial transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) revealed a heterogeneous hypoechoic mass measuring 3.2 cm × 2.8 cm × 3.0 cm in the right uterine wall containing linear hyperechoic areas.

pmc-13580763.creator: Maher Zoubi, Patrick Weydt, Xenia Kobeleva
pmc-13580763.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13588312.title: Engineering a self-protecting dermal filler: active hyaluronidase inhibition extends the in vivo persistence of cross-linked hyaluronic acid hydrogels
pmc-13588312.creator: Kamil Budak, Umran Aydemir Sezer
pmc-13588312.description: Hyaluronic acid (HA) is a naturally occurring polysaccharide with high biocompatibility and an exceptional capacity for water retention, making it a critical component in drug delivery and soft tissue applications. However, native HA exhibits a very short in vivo half-life due to rapid enzymatic degradation.

pmc-13640388.title: Explainable early prediction of short-term severe deterioration in gallstone-related biliary disease using MIMIC-IV, eICU, and local real-world data
pmc-13640388.creator: Qianli Chen, Xiaoxiong Wu
pmc-13640388.description: BackgroundPatients with gallstone-related biliary disease may deteriorate rapidly before definitive source control. This study aimed to develop an interpretable 0-24-hour prediction model for short-term severe deterioration in gallstone-related biliary disease and validate it across eICU-CRD and a local real-world cohort.MethodsMIMIC-IV was used for model development, eICU-CRD for primary external validation, and local clinical data for secondary validation.
